title: Wilson Fierce Max 13mm Pickleball Paddle, Blue/Navy
writeup: The Wilson Fierce Max 13mm pickleball paddle in Blue/Navy (ASIN B0CQ5JZVW7, UPC 097512809436) is $24.99 new on Woot with three left and a purchase limit of three. Ace Sports lists the exact UPC match in stock at $59.00, and ProAm Tennis has the matching 13mm textured fiberglass paddle at $109. That puts Woot 57% below the lowest verified live tag. Specs match across listings: textured fiberglass face, 13mm polypropylene honeycomb core, about 8.25 oz.
